items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Philip Marrera' in the context of identifying people in photographs ('Philip Marrera's king'), but there is no evidence of a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction with Eddie Marrero.

ctx.x: Marrero. Phillip Herrera. And she is Sandra Pelabon. Is it on there?
I used to know Eddie Marrero and Lawrence Marrero. Where? Probably some kind of cousin.
